g.text: C4-Helix: graph for transversal SWAP gauging

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526273

g.text: 10 vertices · 20 edges · degree 4 at every vertex

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526273

g.text: Only labelled circles are vertices; crossings of lines are not connections.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526273

g.text: Each vertex carries a temporary ancilla. Each edge carries one gauge qubit. Layout is schematic.
